scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check packages
scripts.doctor: cd backend && uv run --package lang3s-services python -m lang3s.services.doctor
scripts.filestore:verify: cd backend && uv run --package lang3s-services python -m lang3s.services.filestore verify
scripts.filestore:sync: cd backend && uv run --package lang3s-services python -m lang3s.services.filestore sync
scripts.test:python: cd backend && uv run pytest -q -p no:tach tests
scripts.reset: cd frontend && pnpm reset && cd ../backend && pnpm reset
